CHE Graduate Program Application Requirements
Assistant Professors Harishankar Manikantan, Ambarish Kulkarni, Coleman Kronawitter, Jiandi Wan, Jason White, Priya Shah and Matt Ellis. Photo: UC Davis/Josh Moy.
Apply Now!
We're proud of our graduate students and graduate program. Learn more about our students, our research and how you can join us.
The application period for each academic year opens in September of the preceding year, and applications are due by January 15th. Application materials (ex. letters of recommendation and essays) must be received by February 1st to guarantee full consideration. While we accept applications until June 1st, this is on a space-available basis only, and your application is not guaranteed to be reviewed.
Applications are submitted via the Graduate Studies online application. Application fees are $120 for domestic students and $140 for international students. Waivers may be granted to students who participate in a recognized graduate preparation program. We cannot accept applications or additional application materials outside of the application system.
The GRE is no longer required. Please note, English language testing will still be required if English was not the sole language of instruction at your undergraduate institution. Further information regarding English language testing may be found below.
There are four main components of the application:
Expand All | Collapse All
1. GPA and Transcripts
2. Standardized Testing (GRE, TOEFL, IELTS)
3. Letters of Recommendation
4. Statement of Purpose and Personal Statement
For more information or assistance, see our Frequently Asked Questions page or contact our Graduate Advisors.
